description: Labels every pixel of a street photo with one of the 19 Cityscapes classes: road, sidewalk, building, vegetation, terrain, sky, cars, people and more. Small and fast: it runs on a CPU with onnxruntime, about a fifth of a second per image, and needs no download.

model.publisher: DDRNet authors; ONNX export by Qualcomm AI Hub Models (v0.63.0, w8a8)

name: DDRNet23-Slim (street scenes)

templates.description: Label every pixel of each image with a Model Catalog model: drag a model onto the node to choose it. Input: a collection's rows, each with a path (Data Loading on street-level images). Output: the same rows with one column per class asked for (its share of the image's pixels, in percent), dominant_class, dominant_pct and an overlay_url a Simple View shows.
